nature_language: 当前位置成都。我一个人想去北京玩4天，预算10000人民币，坐火车往返，住一间单床房，麻烦给我一个旅行规划。
nature_language_en: Current location: Chengdu. I want to travel alone to Beijing for 4 days with a budget of 10,000 RMB. I plan to take the train round-trip and stay in a single room. Could you please provide me with a travel itinerary?
